scope: Theorem 10.1 (Auxiliary volume equation) of the manuscript “Deforming hypersymplectic four-manifolds to hyperkähler triples” (preprints/Deforming-hypersymplectic-four-manifolds-to-hyperkahler-triples-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 341 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 92c36602fb496808), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every sufficiently small ε > 0 there is a smooth closed real two-form Dε such that (10.2) A ∧ Dε = C ∧ Dε = 0, D2 ε = A2 , and (A, C, Dε) is a positive triple. Its sign agrees with positive area on the oriented fibers. The construction uses an auxiliary cohomology class, whose relation to the required class [B] is stated in Theorem 10.2.
